hypothesis: A bounded source-faithful max-min SLSQP search with small multistart perturbations can escape the Comellas-Yebra 12-point construction and produce a float64 minimum-area improvement suitable for subsequent exact/certified verification.
rationale: The source-faithful baseline is independently reproduced, while the protected Markdown transcription is known inconsistent and will not be used. SLSQP directly maximizes a common lower bound on all 220 oriented triangle areas, providing a materially different continuous optimization family from the blocked transcription and a controlled way to test local stability.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether the published construction is locally stable under a fixed-orientation max-min formulation and whether a promising candidate exists that justifies expensive high-precision certification.
method: Load the source-faithful baseline coordinates from artifacts/baselines/heilbronn_comellas_yebra.json. Use 12 random-normal perturbation starts plus the baseline, optimize 24 coordinates and a common area lower-bound variable with scipy SLSQP, bounds [0,1], all 220 baseline orientation constraints, seed 20260827, and max 500 iterations per start. Record float64 minima only; do not treat them as certified improvements.
metric: float64 minimum of all 220 triangle areas and improvement over the source-faithful exact baseline approximation
metric_relation_to_true_objective: The minimum triangle area is the true objective, but float64 output is only an experimental signal. Any apparent improvement requires independent high-precision and exact/interval certification before comparison to the frozen baseline.
kill_condition: Stop after the configured starts or a clear optimizer failure; do not expand the search or claim a record from float64 movement alone.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: float64 improvement is only a candidate signal; certification required

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only after high-precision/certified verification

interpretation: Twelve fixed-orientation SLSQP starts from the source-faithful Comellas-Yebra coordinates returned to the published minimum within float64 noise; no float64 improvement was found. This is local optimization evidence only and is not a certified negative result or improvement claim.
what_was_learned: The published source-faithful construction appears locally stable under this max-min SLSQP chart and small perturbations. Further retuning of the same local optimizer is low-value; any future Heilbronn work needs a different global parameterization and remains subject to the foundation transcription blocker for official comparison.
recommended_next_action: If float64 improvement is substantial, run independent Decimal/SymPy or interval verification on all 220 triangles; otherwise pause this local family and avoid optimizing the invalid protected transcription.
repetition_justification: This is the first Heilbronn optimization experiment and changes from baseline reproduction to a continuous max-min SLSQP formulation. It uses only source-faithful coordinates and does not rely on the protected transcription defect.
